settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.seedsTheModelAndEffortA: Seeds the model and effort a delegated task starts with.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.noRulesEachTurnUsesThe: No rules. Each turn uses the provider's default model, adjusted for your preference.

settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.notInDefaultSelectItTo: Not in Default. Select it to let Auto use it.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.whatAutoMayReadBeforeIt: What Auto may read before it picks a route.

settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.changesToAuthSecretsPaymentsOr: Changes to auth, secrets, payments, or production data route as Complex work or higher.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.aPromptThatStartsWithA: A prompt that starts with a skill, such as /ship or $ship, can match rules that name it.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.letAutoMoveATaskTo: Let Auto move a task to the other provider by preference. A provider that cannot run the turn hands over either way.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.readsTheTightestAccountUsageWindow: Reads the tightest account usage window. Never routes below a level's minimum model.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.lowerEffortThenTheModelAs: Lower effort, then the model, as account usage climbs.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.oneEffortStepLowerOrOne: One effort step lower, or one model lower.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.theLeastExpensiveModelTheLevel: The least expensive model the level allows.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.theLevelsAboveAreTheseRules: The levels above are these rules. First enabled match wins, top to bottom; every condition in a rule must hold. Its reason is shown on the route line.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.previewTheLocalRulesWithHeuristic: Preview the local rules with heuristic signals. No AI call is made; model classification can produce a different route.
settingsDialogAutoRoutingSection.eGPlanTheMigrationOf: e.g. Plan the migration of the settings dialog to StyleX
